CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feedback_comment_touch_activity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.admin_issues
  set
    last_activity_at = new.created_at,
    last_admin_activity_at = case when new.is_admin then new.created_at else last_admin_activity_at end,
    last_user_activity_at = case when new.is_admin then last_user_activity_at else new.created_at end
  where id = new.issue_id;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_submission_quarter()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select value::integer
  from public.app_settings
  where key = 'current_submission_quarter';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.current_submission_year()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select value::integer
  from public.app_settings
  where key = 'current_submission_year';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.user_roles (user_id, role, email, full_name)
  values (
    new.id,
    'viewer',
    new.email,
    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name', split_part(coalesce(new.email, ''), '@', 1))
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.user_roles
    where user_id = (select auth.uid())
      and role = 'admin'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_current_submission_period(p_year integer, p_quarter integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_year = private.current_submission_year()
     and p_quarter = private.current_submission_quarter();
$function$
